notes: Fixes the actual Daily Operations iPhone scroll-jump cause: protected-context.js was installing a page-wide MutationObserver that repeatedly removed and rebuilt large protected-detail panels whenever other Daily Operations helpers added content. Those temporary height collapses caused iOS to clamp the scroll position upward. Daily Operations now suppresses only that protected-context mutation observer while retaining Vault session-change, pageshow and visibility updates, plus the secondary scroll guard. No Vault records, checklist items or protected values are changed.
name: TEE v3.5.23 — Daily Operations Protected-Context Stability
